    steps:
      - name: Check out repository history
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22

      - name: Check required repository structure
        run: node scripts/check-required-files.mjs

      - name: Plan change-aware validation
        id: plan
        env:
          CI_EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          CI_PR_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          CI_PUSH_BEFORE_SHA: ${{ github.event.before }}
          CI_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: node scripts/ci-change-plan.mjs

      - name: Check committed patch whitespace
        env:
          CI_EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          CI_PR_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          CI_PUSH_BEFORE_SHA: ${{ github.event.before }}
          CI_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          if [ "$CI_EVENT_NAME" = "pull_request" ]; then
            base="$CI_PR_BASE_SHA"
          else
            base="$CI_PUSH_BEFORE_SHA"
          fi

          if [ -z "$base" ] || printf '%s' "$base" | grep -Eq '^0+$'; then
            base="$(git rev-parse "${CI_HEAD_SHA}^")"
          fi

          git diff --check "${base}...${CI_HEAD_SHA}" -- . ':(exclude)evidence/ai/transcripts/**'

      - name: Validate frozen dependency lockfile
        if: steps.plan.outputs.needsNpm == 'true'
        run: npm ci --dry-run --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund

      - name: Test CI change-routing rules
        run: node --test tests/ci/*.test.mjs

  validation:
    needs: plan
    if: >-
      github.event_name != 'push' &&
      needs.plan.outputs.needsNpm == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 25
    env:
      NODE_ENV: test
      KNIP_DISABLE_RAW_TRANSFER: '1'
      SUPABASE_URL: https://example.invalid
      SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY: test-publishable-key

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # These node tests guard the natural-language evaluation set, which is run by
      # hand against a paid provider â€” a case that silently stops testing anything
      # is only ever discovered by paying for a run. They need the installed
      # dependencies, so they run here rather than in the plan job. Any change under
      # scripts/ selects a full plan, so the needsNpm gate never skips them for a
      # change they could catch.
      - name: Test repository script modules
        if: needs.plan.outputs.needsNpm == 'true'
        run: npm run test:scripts

      - name: Check repository formatting
        run: npm run format:check

      - name: Run monorepo architecture and hygiene checks
        if: needs.plan.outputs.hygiene == 'true'
        run: npm run hygiene

      - name: Verify shared contracts
        if: needs.plan.outputs.contracts == 'true'
        run: |
          npm run lint --workspace=@sport-analytics/contracts
          npm run typecheck --workspace=@sport-analytics/contracts
          npm run test:contracts
          npm run build --workspace=@sport-analytics/contracts

      - name: Verify backend workspace
        if: needs.plan.outputs.backend == 'true'
        run: |
          npm run lint --workspace=@sport-analytics/backend
          npm run typecheck --workspace=@sport-analytics/backend
          npm run test:unit
          npm run test:api
          npm run build --workspace=@sport-analytics/backend

      - name: Verify asynchronous worker workspace
        if: needs.plan.outputs.worker == 'true'
        run: |
          npm run lint --workspace=@sport-analytics/worker
          npm run typecheck --workspace=@sport-analytics/worker
          npm run test:worker
          npm run build --workspace=@sport-analytics/worker

      - name: Verify frontend workspace
        if: needs.plan.outputs.frontend == 'true'
        run: |
          npm run lint --workspace=@sport-analytics/frontend
          npm run typecheck --workspace=@sport-analytics/frontend

        if: needs.plan.outputs.database == 'true'
        run: npm run test:database

      - name: Run deployment-helper tests
        if: needs.plan.outputs.deployment == 'true'
        run: npm run test:deployment

      - name: Lint OpenAPI description
        if: needs.plan.outputs.openapi == 'true'
        run: npm run openapi:lint

      - name: Verify the API implementation against the OpenAPI contract
        if: needs.plan.outputs.apiContract == 'true'
        run: |
          npm run prepare:contracts --workspace=@sport-analytics/backend
          npm run test:api-contract

      - name: Verify Intermediate ingestion acceptance invariants
        if: needs.plan.outputs.intermediateIngestion == 'true'

      - name: Set up Python
        if: needs.plan.outputs.docs == 'true'
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: requirements-docs.txt

      - name: Install documentation dependencies
        if: needs.plan.outputs.docs == 'true'

      - name: Build documentation strictly
        if: needs.plan.outputs.docs == 'true'
        run: python -m mkdocs build --strict

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build shared contracts for browser validation
        run: npm run build --workspace=@sport-analytics/contracts

      - name: Build frontend production bundle once
        env:

        run: npm run build --workspace=@sport-analytics/frontend

      - name: Restore Playwright Chromium cache
        id: playwright-cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/ms-playwright
          key: playwright-ubuntu24-chromium-1.62.1

      - name: Ensure Playwright Chromium system dependencies
        run: npx playwright install-deps chromium

      - name: Install Playwright Chromium on cache miss
        if: steps.playwright-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: npx playwright install chromium

      - name: Run Intermediate ingestion browser acceptance
        if: >-
          needs.plan.outputs.intermediateIngestion == 'true' &&
          needs.plan.outputs.e2eFull != 'true'
        env:
          NODE_ENV: production
        run: >-
          npm run test:e2e --
          tests/e2e/submissions.spec.ts
          tests/e2e/batch-review-workspace.spec.ts
          tests/e2e/corrections.spec.ts

      - name: Confirm full browser suite covers Intermediate ingestion acceptance
        if: >-
          needs.plan.outputs.intermediateIngestion == 'true' &&

      - name: Run browser and accessibility tests

          DATABASE_SECRET_URI: ${{ secrets.AZURE_BACKEND_DATABASE_SECRET_URI }}
        run: |
          echo "Applying reviewed backend database migrations before backend activation."
          DATABASE_URL="$(az keyvault secret show --id "$DATABASE_SECRET_URI" --query value --output tsv)"

          if [ -z "$DATABASE_URL" ]; then
            echo "::error::The backend database secret resolved to an empty value."
            exit 1
          fi

          export DATABASE_URL
          npm run db:migrate --workspace=@sport-analytics/backend

      - name: Sign in to Azure Container Registry
        run: az acr login --name "$ACR_NAME"

      - name: Prepare Docker Buildx
        run: |
          docker buildx version

          docker buildx rm -f backend-ci-builder >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

          docker buildx create \
            --name backend-ci-builder \
            --driver docker-container \
            --driver-opt network=host \
            --buildkitd-flags '--allow-insecure-entitlement network.host' \
            --use \
            --bootstrap

          docker buildx inspect

      - name: Verify Buildx npm registry connectivity
        shell: bash
        run: |
          timeout 60s docker buildx build \
            --progress=plain \
            --allow network.host \
            --network=host \
            --file - \
            . <<'EOF'
          FROM node:22-bookworm-slim
          RUN npm ping --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/
          EOF

      - name: Build immutable backend container image
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          build_log="$(mktemp)"
          trap 'rm -f "$build_log"' EXIT

            if ! docker buildx build \
              --progress=plain \
              --allow network.host \
              --network=host \
              --cache-from "type=registry,ref=$ACR_NAME.azurecr.io/sport-analytics-api:buildcache" \
              --cache-to "type=registry,ref=$ACR_NAME.azurecr.io/sport-analytics-api:buildcache,mode=max" \
              --file apps/backend/Dockerfile \
              --tag "$ACR_NAME.azurecr.io/sport-analytics-api:${{ github.sha }}" \
              --load \
              . 2>&1 | tee "$build_log"; then

            if grep -Fq 'Exit handler never called!' "$build_log"; then
              echo '::error::Backend Docker build failed: npm internal crash (Exit handler never called).'
            elif grep -Eqi 'EAI_AGAIN|ENOTFOUND|ECONNREFUSED|ECONNRESET|ETIMEDOUT|fetch failed' "$build_log"; then
              echo '::error::Backend Docker build failed: npm registry or Docker network failure.'
            elif grep -Eqi 'ELIFECYCLE|node-gyp|npm error (path|command|code [1-9][0-9]*)' "$build_log"; then
              echo '::error::Backend Docker build failed: lifecycle-script failure.'
            else
              echo '::error::Backend Docker build failed; inspect the BuildKit output above.'
            fi

            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Smoke check backend container image
        run: >-
          npm run smoke:backend-container --
          "$ACR_NAME.azurecr.io/sport-analytics-api:${{ github.sha }}"

      - name: Push immutable backend image to Azure Container Registry
        run: docker push "$ACR_NAME.azurecr.io/sport-analytics-api:${{ github.sha }}"

      - name: Deploy backend Container Apps revision
        env:
          RESOURCE_GROUP: ${{ secrets.AZURE_BACKEND_CONTAINER_RESOURCE_GROUP }}
          DATABASE_SECRET_URI: ${{ secrets.AZURE_BACKEND_DATABASE_SECRET_URI }}
          SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY_SECRET_URI: ${{ secrets.AZURE_BACKEND_SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY_SECRET_URI }}
          ANONYMOUS_RATE_LIMIT_SECRET_URI: ${{ secrets.AZURE_BACKEND_ANONYMOUS_RATE_LIMIT_SECRET_URI }}
          LLM_API_KEY_SECRET_URI: ${{ secrets.AZURE_BACKEND_LLM_API_KEY_SECRET_URI }}
          CORS_ORIGINS: ${{ secrets.AZURE_BACKEND_CORS_ORIGINS }}
          SUPABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.AZURE_BACKEND_SUPABASE_URL }}
          SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY: ${{ secrets.AZURE_BACKEND_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY }}
        run: >-
          az deployment group create
          --name backend-${{ github.sha }}
          --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP"
          --template-file infra/azure/backend/main.bicep
          --parameters
          containerImage="$ACR_NAME.azurecr.io/sport-analytics-api:${{ github.sha }}"
          databaseSecretUri="$DATABASE_SECRET_URI"
          supabaseSecretKeySecretUri="$SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY_SECRET_URI"
          anonymousRateLimitSecretUri="$ANONYMOUS_RATE_LIMIT_SECRET_URI"
          llmApiKeySecretUri="$LLM_API_KEY_SECRET_URI"
          corsOrigins="$CORS_ORIGINS"
          supabaseUrl="$SUPABASE_URL"
          supabasePublishableKey="$SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY"

      - name: Wait for the healthy backend Container Apps revision
        env:
          RESOURCE_GROUP: ${{ secrets.AZURE_BACKEND_CONTAINER_RESOURCE_GROUP }}
        run: |
          EXPECTED_IMAGE="$ACR_NAME.azurecr.io/sport-analytics-api:${{ github.sha }}"

          for attempt in {1..12}; do
            MATCHING_REVISION=$(az containerapp revision list \
              --name "$BACKEND_CONTAINER_APP_NAME" \
              --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
              --query "[?properties.active && properties.healthState=='Healthy' && properties.template.containers[0].image=='$EXPECTED_IMAGE'] | [0].name" \
              -o tsv)

            echo "Backend revision readiness check $attempt/12"

            az containerapp revision list \
              --name "$BACKEND_CONTAINER_APP_NAME" \
              --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
              --query "[?properties.active].{Revision:name,Health:properties.healthState,Image:properties.template.containers[0].image}" \
              -o table

            if [ -n "$MATCHING_REVISION" ]; then
              echo "Verified healthy backend revision: $MATCHING_REVISION"
              exit 0
            fi

            sleep 10
          done

          echo "::error::Expected backend image $EXPECTED_IMAGE did not become active and healthy within 120 seconds."
          exit 1

      - name: Resolve backend Container Apps HTTPS endpoint
        env:
          RESOURCE_GROUP: ${{ secrets.AZURE_BACKEND_CONTAINER_RESOURCE_GROUP }}
        run: |
          BACKEND_FQDN=$(az containerapp show \
            --name "$BACKEND_CONTAINER_APP_NAME" \
            --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
            --query properties.configuration.ingress.fqdn \
            -o tsv)

          if [ -z "$BACKEND_FQDN" ]; then
            echo "::error::Backend Container App has no external ingress FQDN."
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "BACKEND_URL=https://$BACKEND_FQDN" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Smoke check deployed backend health
        env:
          SMOKE_CHECK_ATTEMPTS: 18
          SMOKE_CHECK_DELAY_MS: 10000
          SMOKE_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MS: 15000
        run: >-
          node scripts/smoke-check-deployment.mjs
          "deployed backend health"
          "$BACKEND_URL/api/v1/health"
          "sport-analytics-api"

      - name: Smoke check deployed database access
        env:
          SMOKE_CHECK_ATTEMPTS: 6
          SMOKE_CHECK_DELAY_MS: 5000
          SMOKE_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MS: 15000
        run: >-
          node scripts/smoke-check-deployment.mjs
          "deployed backend database access"
          "$BACKEND_URL/api/v1/competitions?limit=1"
          "pagination"

      - name: Smoke check deployed dataset-release schema access
        env:
          SMOKE_CHECK_ATTEMPTS: 6
          SMOKE_CHECK_DELAY_MS: 5000
          SMOKE_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MS: 15000
        run: >-
          node scripts/smoke-check-deployment.mjs
          "deployed dataset-release schema access"
          "$BACKEND_URL/api/v1/dataset-releases"
          "data"

  deploy_docs:
    needs:
      - plan
      - quality
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'push' &&
      github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      needs.plan.outputs.deployDocs == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    env:
      DOCS_URL: https://sports-analytics-tool.pages.dev
      CLOUDFLARE_PROJECT_NAME: sports-analytics-tool

    steps:
      - name: Check out validated main commit
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Validate deployment secrets
        env:
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" ]; then
            echo "::error::Required Gitea secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN is not configured."
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ -z "$CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID" ]; then
            echo "::error::Required Gitea secret CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID is not configured."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json

      - name: Install root workspace dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: requirements-docs.txt

      - name: Install documentation dependencies
        run: python -m pip install -r requirements-docs.txt

      - name: Build documentation strictly
        run: python -m mkdocs build --strict

      - name: Deploy documentation to Cloudflare Pages
        env:
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
        run: npx wrangler pages deploy site --project-name=$CLOUDFLARE_PROJECT_NAME

      - name: Smoke check deployed documentation site
        env:
          SMOKE_CHECK_ATTEMPTS: 12
          SMOKE_CHECK_DELAY_MS: 10000
          SMOKE_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MS: 15000
        run: >-
          node scripts/smoke-check-deployment.mjs
          "deployed documentation site"
          "$DOCS_URL/"
          "Sport Analytics Tool"
  deploy_worker:
    needs:
      - plan
      - quality
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'push' &&
      github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      needs.plan.outputs.deployWorker == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Verify worker
        run: |
          npm run lint --workspace=@sport-analytics/worker
          npm run typecheck --workspace=@sport-analytics/worker
          npm run test --workspace=@sport-analytics/worker
          npm run build --workspace=@sport-analytics/worker

      - name: Validate deployment secrets
        env:
          AZURE_WORKER_CREDENTIALS: ${{ secrets.AZURE_WORKER_CREDENTIALS }}
          AZURE_WORKER_RESOURCE_GROUP: ${{ secrets.AZURE_WORKER_RESOURCE_GROUP }}
          AZURE_WORKER_KEY_VAULT_NAME: ${{ secrets.AZURE_WORKER_KEY_VAULT_NAME }}
          AZURE_WORKER_DATABASE_SECRET_URI: ${{ secrets.AZURE_WORKER_DATABASE_SECRET_URI }}
        run: |
          missing=0
          for name in AZURE_WORKER_CREDENTIALS AZURE_WORKER_RESOURCE_GROUP AZURE_WORKER_KEY_VAULT_NAME AZURE_WORKER_DATABASE_SECRET_URI; do
            if [ -z "${!name}" ]; then
              echo "::error::Required Gitea secret $name is not configured."
              missing=1
            fi
          done
          exit "$missing"

      - name: Install Azure CLI
        run: |
          curl -sL https://aka.ms/InstallAzureCLIDeb | sudo bash
          az version

      - name: Sign in to Azure
        uses: azure/login@v2
        with:
          creds: ${{ secrets.AZURE_WORKER_CREDENTIALS }}

      - name: Provision worker infrastructure
        env:
          RESOURCE_GROUP: ${{ secrets.AZURE_WORKER_RESOURCE_GROUP }}
          KEY_VAULT_NAME: ${{ secrets.AZURE_WORKER_KEY_VAULT_NAME }}
          DATABASE_SECRET_URI: ${{ secrets.AZURE_WORKER_DATABASE_SECRET_URI }}
        run: >-
          az deployment group create
          --name worker-${{ github.sha }}-infra
          --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP"
          --template-file infra/azure/worker/main.bicep
          --parameters deployWorker=false minReplicas=1
          keyVaultName="$KEY_VAULT_NAME"
          databaseSecretUri="$DATABASE_SECRET_URI"
          storageAccountName=statsthegameblobdev

      - name: Verify Docker npm registry connectivity
        run: |
          MAX_CONNECTIVITY_ATTEMPTS=4
          CONNECTIVITY_RETRY_BASE_SECONDS=5

          for attempt in $(seq 1 "$MAX_CONNECTIVITY_ATTEMPTS"); do
            echo "Docker npm registry connectivity attempt $attempt/$MAX_CONNECTIVITY_ATTEMPTS"

            echo "Checking DNS resolution inside Docker..."
            if ! docker run --rm --network=host node:22-bookworm-slim \
              node -e "require('dns').lookup('registry.npmjs.org', (error, address) => { if (error) { console.error(error); process.exit(1); } console.log('registry.npmjs.org ->', address); })"; then
              failure_stage="DNS resolution"
            else
              echo "Checking npm registry connectivity inside Docker..."
              if docker run --rm --network=host node:22-bookworm-slim \
                npm ping --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/; then
                echo "Docker npm registry connectivity verified."
                exit 0
              fi
              failure_stage="npm registry connectivity"
            fi

            if [ "$attempt" -eq "$MAX_CONNECTIVITY_ATTEMPTS" ]; then
              echo "::error::Docker npm registry connectivity failed after $MAX_CONNECTIVITY_ATTEMPTS attempts; last failure: $failure_stage."
              exit 1
            fi

            retry_delay=$((CONNECTIVITY_RETRY_BASE_SECONDS * (2 ** (attempt - 1))))
            echo "::warning::Docker npm registry connectivity attempt $attempt/$MAX_CONNECTIVITY_ATTEMPTS failed during $failure_stage; retrying in ${retry_delay}s."
            sleep "$retry_delay"
          done

      - name: Build immutable worker image and push to Azure Container Registry
        env:
          RESOURCE_GROUP: ${{ secrets.AZURE_WORKER_RESOURCE_GROUP }}
        run: |
          INFRA_DEPLOYMENT_NAME="worker-${{ github.sha }}-infra"

          ACR_NAME=$(az deployment group show \
            --name "$INFRA_DEPLOYMENT_NAME" \
            --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
            --query properties.outputs.containerRegistryName.value \
            -o tsv)

          ACR_SERVER=$(az deployment group show \
            --name "$INFRA_DEPLOYMENT_NAME" \
            --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
            --query properties.outputs.containerRegistryServer.value \
            -o tsv)

          echo "Building worker image for registry $ACR_NAME"

          az acr login --name "$ACR_NAME"

          docker pull "$ACR_SERVER/sport-analytics-worker:buildcache" || true

          DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker build \
            --network=host \
            --file apps/worker/Dockerfile \
            --build-arg BUILDKIT_INLINE_CACHE=1 \
            --cache-from "$ACR_SERVER/sport-analytics-worker:buildcache" \
            --tag "$ACR_SERVER/sport-analytics-worker:${{ github.sha }}" \
            --tag "$ACR_SERVER/sport-analytics-worker:buildcache" \
            .

          docker push "$ACR_SERVER/sport-analytics-worker:${{ github.sha }}"
          docker push "$ACR_SERVER/sport-analytics-worker:buildcache"

          echo "ACR_NAME=$ACR_NAME" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "ACR_SERVER=$ACR_SERVER" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Deploy worker revision
        env:
          RESOURCE_GROUP: ${{ secrets.AZURE_WORKER_RESOURCE_GROUP }}
          KEY_VAULT_NAME: ${{ secrets.AZURE_WORKER_KEY_VAULT_NAME }}
          DATABASE_SECRET_URI: ${{ secrets.AZURE_WORKER_DATABASE_SECRET_URI }}
        run: >-
          az deployment group create
          --name worker-${{ github.sha }}
          --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP"
          --template-file infra/azure/worker/main.bicep
          --parameters deployWorker=true minReplicas=1
          containerImage="$ACR_NAME.azurecr.io/sport-analytics-worker:${{ github.sha }}"
          keyVaultName="$KEY_VAULT_NAME"
          databaseSecretUri="$DATABASE_SECRET_URI"
          storageAccountName=statsthegameblobdev

      - name: Verify active revision image and health
        env:
          RESOURCE_GROUP: ${{ secrets.AZURE_WORKER_RESOURCE_GROUP }}
        run: |
          EXPECTED_IMAGE="$ACR_SERVER/sport-analytics-worker:${{ github.sha }}"
          LIVE_MIN_REPLICAS=$(az containerapp show \
            --name statsthegame-dev-batch-worker \
            --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
            --query 'properties.template.scale.minReplicas' \
            -o tsv)

          if [ "$LIVE_MIN_REPLICAS" != "1" ]; then
            echo "::error::Worker minimum replicas is $LIVE_MIN_REPLICAS; expected 1."
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Expected worker image: $EXPECTED_IMAGE"
          echo "Verified worker minimum replicas: $LIVE_MIN_REPLICAS"

          for attempt in {1..12}; do
            MATCHING_REVISION=$(az containerapp revision list \
              --name statsthegame-dev-batch-worker \
              --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
              --query "[?properties.active && properties.healthState=='Healthy' && properties.template.containers[0].image=='$EXPECTED_IMAGE'] | [0].name" \
              -o tsv)

            echo "Worker verification $attempt/12"

            az containerapp revision list \
              --name statsthegame-dev-batch-worker \
              --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
              --query "[?properties.active].{Revision:name,Health:properties.healthState,Image:properties.template.containers[0].image}" \
              -o table

            if [ -n "$MATCHING_REVISION" ]; then
              echo "Verified healthy active worker revision: $MATCHING_REVISION"
              echo "Verified worker image: $EXPECTED_IMAGE"
              exit 0
            fi

            sleep 10
          done

          echo "::error::Expected worker image $EXPECTED_IMAGE did not become active and healthy within 120 seconds."
          exit 1

  coverage:
    needs:
      - plan
      - quality
      - deploy_frontend
      - deploy_backend
      - deploy_docs
      - deploy_worker
    if: >-
      always() &&
      needs.plan.outputs.coverage == 'true' &&
      needs.quality.result == 'success'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: write
    env:
      NODE_ENV: test
      SUPABASE_URL: https://example.invalid
      SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY: test-publishable-key
      COVERAGE_THRESHOLD_LINES: ${{ vars.COVERAGE_THRESHOLD_LINES }}
      COVERAGE_THRESHOLD_STATEMENTS: ${{ vars.COVERAGE_THRESHOLD_STATEMENTS }}
      COVERAGE_THRESHOLD_FUNCTIONS: ${{ vars.COVERAGE_THRESHOLD_FUNCTIONS }}
      COVERAGE_THRESHOLD_BRANCHES: ${{ vars.COVERAGE_THRESHOLD_BRANCHES }}

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Generate repository-wide coverage
        id: repository_coverage
        shell: bash
        run: |
          mkdir -p coverage
          set +e
          npm run test:coverage
          coverage_exit_code=$?
          set -e

          echo "exit_code=$coverage_exit_code" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          if [ "$coverage_exit_code" -eq 0 ]; then
            printf 'Coverage: PASS\n' > coverage/ci-status.txt
            echo "Repository coverage completed successfully."
          else
            printf 'Coverage: FAILED / INCOMPLETE\nExit code: %s\n' "$coverage_exit_code" > coverage/ci-status.txt
            echo "::warning::Coverage FAILED / INCOMPLETE (exit code $coverage_exit_code). Quality and deployment have already completed; retaining this as non-blocking evidence."
          fi

          # Coverage is a late evidence signal. Preserve the real exit code as
          # output/status evidence without turning it back into a deployment gate.
          exit 0

      - name: Upload repository coverage reports
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: repository-coverage-${{ github.sha }}
          path: coverage/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Publish live coverage badge
        if: steps.repository_coverage.outputs.exit_code == '0' && github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cp coverage/combined/badge.svg "$RUNNER_TEMP/coverage-badge.svg"

          git config user.name "gitea-actions"
          git config user.email "actions@users.noreply.sdp.ms.wits.ac.za"

          git fetch origin coverage-badge || true
          if git show-ref --verify --quiet refs/remotes/origin/coverage-badge; then
            git switch -C coverage-badge origin/coverage-badge
          else
            git switch --orphan coverage-badge
            git rm -rf . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
          fi

          cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/coverage-badge.svg" badge.svg
          git add badge.svg
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "Coverage badge is already current."
            exit 0
          fi

          git commit -m "chore(coverage): update live badge"
          git push origin coverage-badge

      - name: Report repository coverage status
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if [ "${{ steps.repository_coverage.outputs.exit_code }}" = "0" ]; then
            echo "Repository coverage evidence completed successfully."
          else
            echo "::warning::Repository coverage FAILED / INCOMPLETE. This late evidence signal did not gate quality or deployment."
          fi
item.aggregated_output:
name: Sport Analytics CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  plan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      full: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.full }}
      evidence: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.evidence }}
      docs: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.docs }}
      frontend: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.frontend }}
      lighthouse: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.lighthouse }}
      backend: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.backend }}
      worker: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.worker }}
      contracts: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.contracts }}
      database: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.database }}
      e2e: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.e2e }}
      e2eFull: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.e2eFull }}
      intermediateIngestion: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.intermediateIngestion }}
      hygiene: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.hygiene }}
      deployment: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.deployment }}
      openapi: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.openapi }}
      apiContract: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.apiContract }}
      coverage: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.coverage }}
      deployFrontend: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.deployFrontend }}
      deployBackend: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.deployBackend }}
      deployWorker: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.deployWorker }}
      deployDocs: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.deployDocs }}
      needsNpm: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.needsNpm }}

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository history
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22

      - name: Check required repository structure
        run: node scripts/check-required-files.mjs

      - name: Plan change-aware validation
        id: plan
        env:
          CI_EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          CI_PR_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          CI_PUSH_BEFORE_SHA: ${{ github.event.before }}
          CI_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: node scripts/ci-change-plan.mjs

      - name: Check committed patch whitespace
        env:
          CI_EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          CI_PR_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          CI_PUSH_BEFORE_SHA: ${{ github.event.before }}
          CI_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          if [ "$CI_EVENT_NAME" = "pull_request" ]; then
            base="$CI_PR_BASE_SHA"
          else
            base="$CI_PUSH_BEFORE_SHA"
          fi

          if [ -z "$base" ] || printf '%s' "$base" | grep -Eq '^0+$'; then
            base="$(git rev-parse "${CI_HEAD_SHA}^")"
          fi

          git diff --check "${base}...${CI_HEAD_SHA}" -- . ':(exclude)evidence/ai/transcripts/**'

      - name: Validate frozen dependency lockfile
        if: steps.plan.outputs.needsNpm == 'true'
        run: npm ci --dry-run --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund

      - name: Test CI change-routing rules
        run: node --test tests/ci/*.test.mjs

  validation:
    needs: plan
    if: >-
      github.event_name != 'push' &&
      needs.plan.outputs.needsNpm == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 25
    env:
      NODE_ENV: test
      KNIP_DISABLE_RAW_TRANSFER: '1'
      SUPABASE_URL: https://example.invalid
      SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY: test-publishable-key

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm

      - name: Deploy documentation to Cloudflare Pages
        env:
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
        run: npx wrangler pages deploy site --project-name=$CLOUDFLARE_PROJECT_NAME

      - name: Smoke check deployed documentation site
        env:
          SMOKE_CHECK_ATTEMPTS: 12
          SMOKE_CHECK_DELAY_MS: 10000
          SMOKE_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MS: 15000
        run: >-
          node scripts/smoke-check-deployment.mjs
          "deployed documentation site"
          "$DOCS_URL/"
          "Sport Analytics Tool"
  deploy_worker:
    needs:
      - plan
      - quality
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'push' &&
      github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      needs.plan.outputs.deployWorker == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Verify worker
        run: |
          npm run lint --workspace=@sport-analytics/worker
          npm run typecheck --workspace=@sport-analytics/worker
          npm run test --workspace=@sport-analytics/worker
          npm run build --workspace=@sport-analytics/worker

      - name: Validate deployment secrets
        env:
          AZURE_WORKER_CREDENTIALS: ${{ secrets.AZURE_WORKER_CREDENTIALS }}
          AZURE_WORKER_RESOURCE_GROUP: ${{ secrets.AZURE_WORKER_RESOURCE_GROUP }}
          AZURE_WORKER_KEY_VAULT_NAME: ${{ secrets.AZURE_WORKER_KEY_VAULT_NAME }}
          AZURE_WORKER_DATABASE_SECRET_URI: ${{ secrets.AZURE_WORKER_DATABASE_SECRET_URI }}
        run: |
          missing=0
          for name in AZURE_WORKER_CREDENTIALS AZURE_WORKER_RESOURCE_GROUP AZURE_WORKER_KEY_VAULT_NAME AZURE_WORKER_DATABASE_SECRET_URI; do
            if [ -z "${!name}" ]; then
              echo "::error::Required Gitea secret $name is not configured."
              missing=1
            fi
          done
          exit "$missing"

      - name: Install Azure CLI
        run: |
          curl -sL https://aka.ms/InstallAzureCLIDeb | sudo bash
          az version

      - name: Sign in to Azure
        uses: azure/login@v2
        with:
          creds: ${{ secrets.AZURE_WORKER_CREDENTIALS }}

      - name: Provision worker infrastructure
        env:
          RESOURCE_GROUP: ${{ secrets.AZURE_WORKER_RESOURCE_GROUP }}
          KEY_VAULT_NAME: ${{ secrets.AZURE_WORKER_KEY_VAULT_NAME }}
          DATABASE_SECRET_URI: ${{ secrets.AZURE_WORKER_DATABASE_SECRET_URI }}
        run: >-
          az deployment group create
          --name worker-${{ github.sha }}-infra
          --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP"
          --template-file infra/azure/worker/main.bicep
          --parameters deployWorker=false minReplicas=1
          keyVaultName="$KEY_VAULT_NAME"
          databaseSecretUri="$DATABASE_SECRET_URI"
          storageAccountName=statsthegameblobdev

      - name: Verify Docker npm registry connectivity
        run: |
          MAX_CONNECTIVITY_ATTEMPTS=4
          CONNECTIVITY_RETRY_BASE_SECONDS=5

          for attempt in $(seq 1 "$MAX_CONNECTIVITY_ATTEMPTS"); do
            echo "Docker npm registry connectivity attempt $attempt/$MAX_CONNECTIVITY_ATTEMPTS"

            echo "Checking DNS resolution inside Docker..."
            if ! docker run --rm --network=host node:22-bookworm-slim \
              node -e "require('dns').lookup('registry.npmjs.org', (error, address) => { if (error) { console.error(error); process.exit(1); } console.log('registry.npmjs.org ->', address); })"; then
              failure_stage="DNS resolution"
            else
              echo "Checking npm registry connectivity inside Docker..."
              if docker run --rm --network=host node:22-bookworm-slim \
                npm ping --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/; then
                echo "Docker npm registry connectivity verified."
                exit 0
              fi
              failure_stage="npm registry connectivity"
            fi

            if [ "$attempt" -eq "$MAX_CONNECTIVITY_ATTEMPTS" ]; then
              echo "::error::Docker npm registry connectivity failed after $MAX_CONNECTIVITY_ATTEMPTS attempts; last failure: $failure_stage."
              exit 1
            fi

            retry_delay=$((CONNECTIVITY_RETRY_BASE_SECONDS * (2 ** (attempt - 1))))
            echo "::warning::Docker npm registry connectivity attempt $attempt/$MAX_CONNECTIVITY_ATTEMPTS failed during $failure_stage; retrying in ${retry_delay}s."
            sleep "$retry_delay"
          done

      - name: Build immutable worker image and push to Azure Container Registry
        env:
          RESOURCE_GROUP: ${{ secrets.AZURE_WORKER_RESOURCE_GROUP }}
        run: |
          INFRA_DEPLOYMENT_NAME="worker-${{ github.sha }}-infra"

          ACR_NAME=$(az deployment group show \
            --name "$INFRA_DEPLOYMENT_NAME" \
            --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
            --query properties.outputs.containerRegistryName.value \
            -o tsv)

          ACR_SERVER=$(az deployment group show \
            --name "$INFRA_DEPLOYMENT_NAME" \
            --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
            --query properties.outputs.containerRegistryServer.value \
            -o tsv)

          echo "Building worker image for registry $ACR_NAME"

          az acr login --name "$ACR_NAME"

          docker pull "$ACR_SERVER/sport-analytics-worker:buildcache" || true

          DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker build \
            --network=host \
            --file apps/worker/Dockerfile \
            --build-arg BUILDKIT_INLINE_CACHE=1 \
            --cache-from "$ACR_SERVER/sport-analytics-worker:buildcache" \
            --tag "$ACR_SERVER/sport-analytics-worker:${{ github.sha }}" \
            --tag "$ACR_SERVER/sport-analytics-worker:buildcache" \
            .

          docker push "$ACR_SERVER/sport-analytics-worker:${{ github.sha }}"
          docker push "$ACR_SERVER/sport-analytics-worker:buildcache"

          echo "ACR_NAME=$ACR_NAME" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "ACR_SERVER=$ACR_SERVER" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Deploy worker revision
        env:
          RESOURCE_GROUP: ${{ secrets.AZURE_WORKER_RESOURCE_GROUP }}
          KEY_VAULT_NAME: ${{ secrets.AZURE_WORKER_KEY_VAULT_NAME }}
          DATABASE_SECRET_URI: ${{ secrets.AZURE_WORKER_DATABASE_SECRET_URI }}
        run: >-
          az deployment group create
          --name worker-${{ github.sha }}
          --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP"
          --template-file infra/azure/worker/main.bicep
          --parameters deployWorker=true minReplicas=1
          containerImage="$ACR_NAME.azurecr.io/sport-analytics-worker:${{ github.sha }}"
          keyVaultName="$KEY_VAULT_NAME"
          databaseSecretUri="$DATABASE_SECRET_URI"
          storageAccountName=statsthegameblobdev

      - name: Verify active revision image and health
        env:
          RESOURCE_GROUP: ${{ secrets.AZURE_WORKER_RESOURCE_GROUP }}
        run: |
          EXPECTED_IMAGE="$ACR_SERVER/sport-analytics-worker:${{ github.sha }}"
          LIVE_MIN_REPLICAS=$(az containerapp show \
            --name statsthegame-dev-batch-worker \
            --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
            --query 'properties.template.scale.minReplicas' \
            -o tsv)

          if [ "$LIVE_MIN_REPLICAS" != "1" ]; then
            echo "::error::Worker minimum replicas is $LIVE_MIN_REPLICAS; expected 1."
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Expected worker image: $EXPECTED_IMAGE"
          echo "Verified worker minimum replicas: $LIVE_MIN_REPLICAS"

          for attempt in {1..12}; do
            MATCHING_REVISION=$(az containerapp revision list \
              --name statsthegame-dev-batch-worker \
              --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
              --query "[?properties.active && properties.healthState=='Healthy' && properties.template.containers[0].image=='$EXPECTED_IMAGE'] | [0].name" \
              -o tsv)

            echo "Worker verification $attempt/12"

            az containerapp revision list \
              --name statsthegame-dev-batch-worker \
              --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
              --query "[?properties.active].{Revision:name,Health:properties.healthState,Image:properties.template.containers[0].image}" \
              -o table

            if [ -n "$MATCHING_REVISION" ]; then
              echo "Verified healthy active worker revision: $MATCHING_REVISION"
              echo "Verified worker image: $EXPECTED_IMAGE"
              exit 0
            fi

            sleep 10
          done

          echo "::error::Expected worker image $EXPECTED_IMAGE did not become active and healthy within 120 seconds."
          exit 1

  coverage:
    needs:
      - plan
      - quality
      - deploy_frontend
      - deploy_backend
      - deploy_docs
      - deploy_worker
    if: >-
      always() &&
      needs.plan.outputs.coverage == 'true' &&
      needs.quality.result == 'success'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: write
    env:
      NODE_ENV: test
      SUPABASE_URL: https://example.invalid
      SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY: test-publishable-key
      COVERAGE_THRESHOLD_LINES: ${{ vars.COVERAGE_THRESHOLD_LINES }}
      COVERAGE_THRESHOLD_STATEMENTS: ${{ vars.COVERAGE_THRESHOLD_STATEMENTS }}
      COVERAGE_THRESHOLD_FUNCTIONS: ${{ vars.COVERAGE_THRESHOLD_FUNCTIONS }}
      COVERAGE_THRESHOLD_BRANCHES: ${{ vars.COVERAGE_THRESHOLD_BRANCHES }}

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Generate repository-wide coverage
        id: repository_coverage
        shell: bash
        run: |
          mkdir -p coverage
          set +e
          npm run test:coverage
          coverage_exit_code=$?
          set -e

          echo "exit_code=$coverage_exit_code" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          if [ "$coverage_exit_code" -eq 0 ]; then
            printf 'Coverage: PASS\n' > coverage/ci-status.txt
            echo "Repository coverage completed successfully."
          else
            printf 'Coverage: FAILED / INCOMPLETE\nExit code: %s\n' "$coverage_exit_code" > coverage/ci-status.txt
            echo "::warning::Coverage FAILED / INCOMPLETE (exit code $coverage_exit_code). Quality and deployment have already completed; retaining this as non-blocking evidence."
          fi

          # Coverage is a late evidence signal. Preserve the real exit code as
          # output/status evidence without turning it back into a deployment gate.
          exit 0

      - name: Upload repository coverage reports
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: repository-coverage-${{ github.sha }}
          path: coverage/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Publish live coverage badge
        if: steps.repository_coverage.outputs.exit_code == '0' && github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cp coverage/combined/badge.svg "$RUNNER_TEMP/coverage-badge.svg"

          git config user.name "gitea-actions"
          git config user.email "actions@users.noreply.sdp.ms.wits.ac.za"

          git fetch origin coverage-badge || true
          if git show-ref --verify --quiet refs/remotes/origin/coverage-badge; then
            git switch -C coverage-badge origin/coverage-badge
          else
            git switch --orphan coverage-badge
            git rm -rf . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
          fi

          cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/coverage-badge.svg" badge.svg
          git add badge.svg
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "Coverage badge is already current."
            exit 0
          fi

          git commit -m "chore(coverage): update live badge"
          git push origin coverage-badge

      - name: Report repository coverage status
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if [ "${{ steps.repository_coverage.outputs.exit_code }}" = "0" ]; then
            echo "Repository coverage evidence completed successfully."
          else
            echo "::warning::Repository coverage FAILED / INCOMPLETE. This late evidence signal did not gate quality or deployment."
          fi

name: Sport Analytics CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  plan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      full: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.full }}
      evidence: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.evidence }}
      docs: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.docs }}
      frontend: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.frontend }}
      lighthouse: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.lighthouse }}
      backend: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.backend }}
      worker: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.worker }}
      contracts: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.contracts }}
      database: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.database }}
      e2e: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.e2e }}
      e2eFull: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.e2eFull }}
      intermediateIngestion: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.intermediateIngestion }}
      hygiene: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.hygiene }}
      deployment: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.deployment }}
      openapi: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.openapi }}
      apiContract: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.apiContract }}
      coverage: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.coverage }}
      deployFrontend: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.deployFrontend }}
      deployBackend: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.deployBackend }}
      deployWorker: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.deployWorker }}
      deployDocs: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.deployDocs }}
      needsNpm: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.needsNpm }}

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository history
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22

      - name: Check required repository structure
        run: node scripts/check-required-files.mjs

      - name: Plan change-aware validation
        id: plan
        env:
          CI_EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          CI_PR_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          CI_PUSH_BEFORE_SHA: ${{ github.event.before }}
          CI_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: node scripts/ci-change-plan.mjs

      - name: Check committed patch whitespace
        env:
          CI_EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          CI_PR_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          CI_PUSH_BEFORE_SHA: ${{ github.event.before }}
          CI_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          if [ "$CI_EVENT_NAME" = "pull_request" ]; then
            base="$CI_PR_BASE_SHA"
          else
            base="$CI_PUSH_BEFORE_SHA"
          fi

          if [ -z "$base" ] || printf '%s' "$base" | grep -Eq '^0+$'; then
            base="$(git rev-parse "${CI_HEAD_SHA}^")"
          fi

          git diff --check "${base}...${CI_HEAD_SHA}" -- . ':(exclude)evidence/ai/transcripts/**'

      - name: Validate frozen dependency lockfile
        if: steps.plan.outputs.needsNpm == 'true'
        run: npm ci --dry-run --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund

      - name: Test CI change-routing rules
        run: node --test tests/ci/*.test.mjs

  validation:
    needs: plan
    if: >-
      github.event_name != 'push' &&
      needs.plan.outputs.needsNpm == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 25
    env:
      NODE_ENV: test
      KNIP_DISABLE_RAW_TRANSFER: '1'
      SUPABASE_URL: https://example.invalid
      SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY: test-publishable-key

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # These node tests guard the natural-language evaluation set, which is run by
      # hand against a paid provider â€” a case that silently stops testing anything
      # is only ever discovered by paying for a run. They need the installed
      # dependencies, so they run here rather than in the plan job. Any change under
      # scripts/ selects a full plan, so the needsNpm gate never skips them for a
      # change they could catch.
      - name: Test repository script modules
        if: needs.plan.outputs.needsNpm == 'true'
        run: npm run test:scripts

      - name: Check repository formatting
        run: npm run format:check

      - name: Run monorepo architecture and hygiene checks
        if: needs.plan.outputs.hygiene == 'true'
        run: npm run hygiene

      - name: Verify shared contracts
        if: needs.plan.outputs.contracts == 'true'
        run: |
          npm run lint --workspace=@sport-analytics/contracts
          npm run typecheck --workspace=@sport-analytics/contracts
          npm run test:contracts
          npm run build --workspace=@sport-analytics/contracts

      - name: Verify backend workspace
        if: needs.plan.outputs.backend == 'true'
        run: |
          npm run lint --workspace=@sport-analytics/backend
          npm run typecheck --workspace=@sport-analytics/backend
          npm run test:unit
          npm run test:api
          npm run build --workspace=@sport-analytics/backend

      - name: Verify asynchronous worker workspace
        if: needs.plan.outputs.worker == 'true'
        run: |
          npm run lint --workspace=@sport-analytics/worker
          npm run typecheck --workspace=@sport-analytics/worker
          npm run test:worker
          npm run build --workspace=@sport-analytics/worker

      - name: Verify frontend workspace
        if: needs.plan.outputs.frontend == 'true'
        run: |
          npm run lint --workspace=@sport-analytics/frontend
          npm run typecheck --workspace=@sport-analytics/frontend
          npm run test:frontend -- -- --maxWorkers=2

      - name: Run PostgreSQL database integration tests
        if: needs.plan.outputs.database == 'true'
        run: npm run test:database

      - name: Run deployment-helper tests
        if: needs.plan.outputs.deployment == 'true'
        run: npm run test:deployment

      - name: Lint OpenAPI description
        if: needs.plan.outputs.openapi == 'true'
        run: npm run openapi:lint

      - name: Verify the API implementation against the OpenAPI contract
        if: needs.plan.outputs.apiContract == 'true'
        run: |
          npm run prepare:contracts --workspace=@sport-analytics/backend
          npm run test:api-contract

      - name: Verify Intermediate ingestion acceptance invariants
        if: needs.plan.outputs.intermediateIngestion == 'true'
        run: npm run verify:intermediate-ingestion:invariants

      - name: Set up Python
        if: needs.plan.outputs.docs == 'true'
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: requirements-docs.txt

      - name: Install documentation dependencies
        if: needs.plan.outputs.docs == 'true'
        run: python -m pip install -r requirements-docs.txt

      - name: Build documentation strictly
        if: needs.plan.outputs.docs == 'true'
        run: python -m mkdocs build --strict

  browser:
    needs: plan
    if: >-
      github.event_name != 'push' &&
      needs.plan.outputs.e2e == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    env:
      PLAYWRIGHT_REUSE_BUILD: '1'
      PLAYWRIGHT_WORKERS: '2'
      VITE_SUPABASE_URL: https://e2e.supabase.co
      VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY: e2e-public-key

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build shared contracts for browser validation
        run: npm run build --workspace=@sport-analytics/contracts

      - name: Build frontend production bundle once
        env:
          NODE_ENV: production
        run: npm run build --workspace=@sport-analytics/frontend

      - name: Restore Playwright Chromium cache
        id: playwright-cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/ms-playwright
          key: playwright-ubuntu24-chromium-1.62.1

      - name: Ensure Playwright Chromium system dependencies
        run: npx playwright install-deps chromium

      - name: Install Playwright Chromium on cache miss
        if: steps.playwright-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: npx playwright install chromium

      - name: Run Intermediate ingestion browser acceptance
        if: >-
          needs.plan.outputs.intermediateIngestion == 'true' &&
          needs.plan.outputs.e2eFull != 'true'
        env:
          NODE_ENV: production
        run: >-
          npm run test:e2e --
          tests/e2e/submissions.spec.ts
          tests/e2e/batch-review-workspace.spec.ts
          tests/e2e/corrections.spec.ts

      - name: Confirm full browser suite covers Intermediate ingestion acceptance
        if: >-
          needs.plan.outputs.intermediateIngestion == 'true' &&
          needs.plan.outputs.e2eFull == 'true'
        run: echo "Full browser validation includes the submission, batch-review and correction acceptance journeys."

      - name: Run browser and accessibility tests
        if: needs.plan.outputs.e2eFull == 'true'
        env:
          NODE_ENV: production
        run: npm run test:e2e

  lighthouse:
    needs: plan
    if: >-
      needs.plan.outputs.lighthouse == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      LIGHTHOUSE_RUNS: '3'
      LIGHTHOUSE_GATE_MODE: baseline
      LIGHTHOUSE_OUTPUT_DIR: artifacts/lighthouse-ci
      LIGHTHOUSE_ROUTES: /,/api,/competitions,/seasons,/fixtures,/competitors,/participants,/dataset-releases,/sign-in
      VITE_SUPABASE_URL: https://e2e.supabase.co
      VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY: e2e-public-key

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build production frontend for Lighthouse
        run: |
          npm run build --workspace=@sport-analytics/contracts
          npm run build --workspace=@sport-analytics/frontend

      - name: Restore Playwright Chromium cache
        id: lighthouse-playwright-cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/ms-playwright
          key: playwright-ubuntu24-chromium-1.62.1

      - name: Ensure Playwright Chromium system dependencies
        run: npx playwright install-deps chromium

      - name: Install Playwright Chromium on cache miss
        if: steps.lighthouse-playwright-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: npx playwright install chromium

      - name: Run Lighthouse production-preview baseline
        shell: bash
        run: |
          npm run preview --workspace=@sport-analytics/frontend -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4173 &
          preview_pid=$!
          trap 'kill "$preview_pid" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
          for attempt in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl --fail --silent http://127.0.0.1:4173/ >/dev/null; then
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          curl --fail --silent http://127.0.0.1:4173/ >/dev/null
          export CHROME_PATH="$(node -e "console.log(require('@playwright/test').chromium.executablePath())")"
          echo "Using Chromium: $CHROME_PATH"
          test -x "$CHROME_PATH"

          npm run test:lighthouse

      - name: Upload Lighthouse reports
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: lighthouse-public-baseline-${{ github.sha }}
          path: artifacts/lighthouse-ci
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 30

  quality:
    needs:
      - plan
      - validation
      - browser
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5

    steps:
      - name: Enforce required validation results
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          PLAN_RESULT: ${{ needs.plan.result }}
          VALIDATION_REQUIRED: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.needsNpm }}
          VALIDATION_RESULT: ${{ needs.validation.result }}
          BROWSER_REQUIRED: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.e2e }}
          BROWSER_RESULT: ${{ needs.browser.result }}
          INTERMEDIATE_INGESTION_REQUIRED: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.intermediateIngestion }}
        run: |
          if [ "$PLAN_RESULT" != "success" ]; then
            echo "::error::Change planning did not complete successfully ($PLAN_RESULT)."
            exit 1
          fi

          if [ "$EVENT_NAME" != "push" ]; then
            if [ "$VALIDATION_REQUIRED" = "true" ] && [ "$VALIDATION_RESULT" != "success" ]; then
              echo "::error::Required validation did not complete successfully ($VALIDATION_RESULT)."
              exit 1
